artifact_delivered: Fixed backtest volatility calculation bug — rolling std() vs per-window std(). C503's 'semantics inversion' diagnosis was wrong; real bug was computational. Calibrated thresholds now work correctly: QAE helps MR (+0.425 Sharpe).
workstream_summary: C504: Audited C503's diagnosis. Found that the volatility calculation in mean_reversion_backtest.py was fundamentally wrong — computed std() of all returns in a window instead of rolling std(). The calibrated thresholds (SPY:0.35) were derived using rolling volatility (C489), so they never triggered in the buggy backtest. After fix, QAE helps MR as originally found in C489-C500.
